title: Implement PackedField trait scalar reference impl over Fp<3>
description:
Implement the `PackedField<F>` trait surface fixed by D1b, plus a scalar reference implementation over `Fp<3>` that other W1 packed types can be cross-checked against.

## Background

The trait surface (signatures, `LANES` const, splat / lane / fold_mul placement, alternative-zero canonicalisation semantics) is locked in the D1b approval section. This issue lands those signatures into `gf2-algebra::packed`, plus a trivial scalar reference type `ScalarPackedFp3` whose implementation is one `Fp<3>` per lane (no packing); the reference type exists so T3's bipedal3 implementation has a known-good lane-by-lane cross-check via proptest.

The scalar reference impl is intentionally slow — it is the correctness oracle, not a perf path.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::packed::PackedField` trait exists with the signatures fixed in D1b (LANES, splat, lane, with_lane, all_zero, add, sub, mul, neg).
- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::packed::scalar::ScalarPackedFp3` implements `PackedField<Fp<3>>` via one `Fp<3>` per lane.
- [ ] [hard] Unit tests cover `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg`, lane round-trip, splat, with_lane, all_zero on lane counts of 1, 16, 63, 64, 65 elements.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes.
- [ ] [hard] No `#[ignore]` slow tests added in this issue; everything completes under the 5 s per-test limit.
